== 2012 Autumn Goals, due 12/21/2012 ==
* Book?
** Eric: The most important resource is People, and the book may not be the most effective way to get more people ... Good Works may be more effective, as with Paul Krafel's work in the fields
** Brandon: I agree intellectually, but so many groups have coalesced around a media work (Zeitgeist Movement, Living Universe Foundation) ... also we can have successive versions of the book recording more and more good works, starting with things like the bicycle pump
** Ben: Can our good works as members of other groups count?
** Eric: We can record them in the book but SolSeed can't take credit
** Brandon: Also, how to talk about our good works without people seeing it as bragging?
** Eric: Paul was able to do it, by enthusiastically talking about how that vision is good for the world rather than "holier than thou"
